ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.

20. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

21. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Weather its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Recording weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Interpreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
